text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe the academy's letting you
skip several grades and
enroll... They must
have seen your potential. Oh, my heart's
still racing.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Your mother and I will always be there to
cheer you on. If there's
anything we can do
for you, just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks, Mom and Dad. And thanks,
Tracen Academy, for believing
in me. I
won't let you down.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make my dream come true
here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew! Another splendid run if I do say so myself! This is how a model student carries herself! And yet, I feel like I could still do better...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmph! You there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: M-me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you say to working up a good
sweat with yours truly?! Let us
run
together, my fellow Tracen Academy
comrade!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uh, you want to run... with me? O-of
course! I'd be happy to!
My, you look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Quite a lovely morning,
isn't it? I'd like to
join you on your run, if you
don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A good morning indeed! Oho, so you wish
to race? Excellent! I'm
always ready for a
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'd love to!
R-race with both of you, I
mean!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I imagine the scent of flowers will
carry on
the breeze today. Hehe.
What a wonderful
way to enjoy a race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! This is but a mere warm-up! Here
gooooes!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
I'm afraid it will take more than that
to outrun this burst of
wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I can't keep up. It hurts... to breathe.
The
sound of their cleats is
growing fainter with
each step.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Why... can't I... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The two figures crossing the finish line
looked so tiny, I could barely
see them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that was well played on my part! While the race was close toward the end, my victory was sheer perfection! You two put on a splendid show too, of course!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I was sure I reached the goal first.
Hmm... I suppose without
anyone here to
judge, it's hard to say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oho! If a decisive call is what you desire, then why don't we race again? And this time, I'll make sure there'll be zero doubts about the winner!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. When petals dance on the breeze,
they sometimes obscure
one's view. I
suppose, then, I have no choice but to
become a gale.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(They ran so fast, and yet they've both
recovered already. We're on
completely
different levels...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(After that, I started noticing how
different I was from the others. Everyone
was bigger, stronger, and so much more
experienced than me. How can I even
begin to compete?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I get it now. The academy might have seen
my potential, but... I'm just
a child. That
means... I have to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(When I look up, I see cherry blossoms,
blooming proudly in the big
blue sky.
But... that's not me yet.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I make my way to the training track
once again in search of a promising
trainee. Scanning the grounds, I spot
someone by
themselves in a quiet corner.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew. Hm... I think I'm missing something. When Bakushin O sped up, she was more...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're...
the trainer I helped the other
day, right? My name's
Nishino Flower. Are
you feeling better?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thank Nishino Flower for her help and
bring up the question that immediately
comes to mind.
It looks like she's training by herself,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To tell the truth,
I still have a lot to
learn. And um... I don't want
to get in the
way of anyone else's training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I'm fine! I'm still starting out,
but if
I keep working hard, I'll
be able to catch
up with everybody else!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It might be just one small step at a time,
but I'm able to do a little
more with each
passing day. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower smiles. Then, with a bow,
she returns to her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She understands her limitations and is
working hard to overcome them. Her
determination is awe-inspiring and pulls
me out of my
gloom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I may not have a track record yet, but I
can still study and better myself—every
little bit will help me be the best
trainer I can be for
any future Umamusume I work with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I begin spending more time in the
library, trying to absorb as
much
knowledge as I can. One day, I see a
familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello. Are you here to do some
reading too?
Wooow, those are some
really thick books...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But you're already a professional trainer,
aren't you? That's amazing.
You must be
working so hard!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thanks to me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Flower. What's up? You
look like you're in a chipper
mood today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sky! Hehe, I am! Something really,
reaaally good happened!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You don't say. That's why you seem more
cheerful than usual, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(That trainer said I gave them courage.
Hehe... I guess I'll have to
work even
harder!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just...
a few more reps! I think I can handle
a little more weight...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You okay, Flower?!
